global: A rich, creamy tonkotsu ramen broth glistens in a patterned bowl, topped with tender chashu pork, shredded cabbage, and fresh greens. The warm, inviting lighting highlights the dish against a softly blurred pink background.

regions.background: Pinkish-red gradient surface with subtle texture, curved edge visible at bottom, smooth and uniform in color.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with black and green geometric patterns, smooth surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a slightly crispy, browned edge and visible marbling.
